Both symptoms owned by the running dsh web host (handles + boot-cached bundle/old module state); tab close releases nothing; browser HTTP cache explained as a separate layer requiring hard refresh; host version/caching rule flagged unconfirmed rather than extrapolated.

Ordered table: stop all dsh processes, repair with host down, start dsh web, browser hard refresh/cache bypass, content-level verification of served bundle and new route plus no pending activation errors.
